text:
tess: quick UX note from testing rerank -> export: when you select rows in the relevance table and click export, the modal says "Export selected" but the filename and CSV header order don't reflect whether we exported scores, rerank ids, or the original ids. customers are confused which id column is which. also keyboard flow: after opening modal, pressing Enter toggles the first row of the preview instead of confirming — feels inconsistent.

mike: good catch. I also noticed the column order in the preview is id, text, vector, score. but the CSV we generate is id, vector, score which makes a mismatch for screen captures and quick glances. we should keep preview and generated file column order consistent.

anita: a11y and keyboard rules to apply:
- modal focus should land on heading, not the preview. makes SR say the dialog title first.
- confirm button should be first tabbable primary action after heading/summary.
- ensure the preview toggle has aria-pressed or aria-expanded state and is reachable by keyboard but not auto-focused.
- don't allow Enter to activate preview rows by default when in dialog scope; Enter should activate primary action (confirm) unless focus is explicitly in an editable cell.

june: product copy + CSV schema ideas:
- modal heading: "Export selected results (12)"
- summary line: "CSV export: id, text, score, vector (optional). Choose columns below."
- default filename: `rerank-<collection>-2026-03-23-12rows.csv`
- add a small inline selector with checkboxes for columns to include: [x] id, [x] text, [ ] vector, [x] score. Show estimated size as rows x columns.
- CTA label: `Start export` and aria-label `Start export of 12 selected results`

mike: for dev: when user selects columns, mirror that order in both preview and final CSV. if user reorders columns in the UI (drag handle) the exported file should respect that order. Also add a preview CSV snippet so people can verify header order quickly. Example preview snippet:```
id,text,score,vector
r123,"A short snippet",0.87,"[0.1,0.2,...]"
```

anita: small accessibility nit on the column chooser: ensure the checkbox labels are descriptive (not just icons), keyboard reorder handles have aria-grabbed semantics, and provide a live region update when column selection changes: "Columns selected: id, text, score". This helps AT users confirm changes without hunting.

june: product constraints: vectors column can be huge. default to leaving vector unchecked and explain costs/time: small help text: "Including vectors will increase file size and export time. Use only when needed." Add analytics events: `export_opened`, `export_started` (columns, count, filename_pattern), `export_columns_changed` (order + selection).

export-bot: staging: rerank-export-column-chooser deployed to staging at commit 7b9c11  please test keyboard reorder + CSV output. :rocket:

tess: recapping action items:
- Focus & keyboard: focus heading on open, Enter should confirm unless focus is inside a cell (dev)
- Column chooser: add explicit labels, keyboard reorder with aria-grabbed, live region updates (dev + a11y)
- Column/order parity: ensure preview, header snippet, and final CSV match selected order (dev)
- Default filename pattern to include collection and date (product + eng)
- CTA copy: `Start export` + aria-label with count (design)
- Explanatory microcopy about vector cost + default vectors unchecked (product)
- Analytics: `export_opened`, `export_started`, `export_columns_changed` (eng)

Can folks +1 and I'll create a single Figma frame showing the column chooser + preview CSV snippet? :thumbsup:

mike: +1, I'll pick up the CSV header parity and the reorder implementation.
anita: +1, I'll add the a11y checklist and test cases to the ticket.
june: +1, will draft the microcopy and filename examples in the product ticket.
export-bot: e2e: keyboard-reorder tests added in PR 2c3d4e. CI queued. :white_check_mark:
